shrooming.boundary: Published-state inspection, sandbox reading, greenhouse question probing, and explicit formal greenhouse round advancement remain executable. In the verified active NOSTROMO loop, SHROOMING has a separate feedback-conditioned deterministic reader that reorders inspection lenses when explicit redacted upstream evidence or contradiction signals are present; this makes cross-organ feedback alter SHROOMING behavior rather than merely append text. The formal RUN_READING_ROUND baseline remains parent-invariant v0.9 and unchanged, preserving R111→R112→R113 reproducibility. Neither the feedback-conditioned active-loop reader nor the formal/experimental branches represent semantic learning or ten independently persistent live LLM processes.

muther.boundary: Published mining-state audit and repository corpus mining are executable. MINE_REPO collects repository candidates before bounded selection, fingerprints superficially normalized snippets, suppresses duplicate copies, records occurrence/provenance metadata and round-robins across path-derived source families to reduce first-file bias. This is deterministic structural diversity handling, not semantic clustering, source-quality scoring, novelty proof or truth judgment. Query-scoped Google Drive mining is executed by the authorized external connector runtime and handed back as redacted evidence. MINE_INTERNAL remains limited to explicit authorized query-scoped connector sources; it does not grant exhaustive private-environment crawling or cross-source enumeration. FALSIFY remains repository-scoped and absence is never upgraded to truth.

droplet.boundary: Published evidence audit and explicit-URL verification are executable. Search-engine discovery is executed by the external web connector runtime. VERIFY v1.1 computes SUPPORTED, REFUTED or INDETERMINATE over an explicit evidence bundle while suppressing exact replay amplification, counting caller-supplied source families as audit metadata, forcing INDETERMINATE on conflicting authoritative directions, and flagging contradictory use of one evidence fingerprint. It does not search the web by itself, prove source independence, score methodological quality, or treat absence of refutation as global truth.

gut.boundary: GUT v0.2.24 is a deterministic heuristic metabolic router. It preserves nutrient atoms, routes and provenance while applying bounded carry-rendering containment for inherited substrate, intra-atom and cross-segment echoes, volatile lineage, nested clauses, repeated route metadata and delimiter collisions. Machine-only hexadecimal ref/targetRef/clause/clauseRef identifiers are excluded from prose carry and preserved separately in a bounded carryRefs ledger with path, route, type and provenance, so referential continuity no longer depends on polluting semantic carry text. The verified VAJRA→GUT regression confirms targetRef continuity through carryRefs while the prose summary remains free of those machine tokens. These are deterministic structural normalization and routing rules, not semantic deletion, semantic novelty detection, semantic identity, source-truth judgment or proof that all metabolic echo is solved.

vajra.boundary: VAJRA v0.3.13 retains proposition-aware dismantling, uncertainty/provenance preservation, contest persistence, multi-organ conflict-context routing, replay containment, content-bound history attestation and semantic-operator-preserving replay identity. Its cross-organ provenance-diversity layer now canonicalizes bounded superficial label formatting before collision comparison, so case/spacing/punctuation/symbol mutations of one provenance label cannot masquerade as new source diversity. Raw provenance labels remain preserved for audit. Distinct canonical labels still do not prove real-world source independence. These remain deterministic lexical/structural guards, not cryptographic signatures, semantic adjudication, factual truth, derivative-source detection or real-world source-independence proof.
